messages:
Maya (sec-eng): Quick check — SOC2 fieldwork: we need clear owners for the internal audit-log gating steps. Who's owning ingestion, retention, and evidence export?
Sam (infra): I can take ingestion and S3 pipeline. Will need Lina to confirm retention/TTL knobs.
Lina (platform): I can own retention policy config and retention docs. Need to confirm the exact retention window (90 vs 180d). Any compliance preference?
Auditor-Jen: SOC2 prefers shortest defensible retention; 90d is typically acceptable but we need business signoff if we shorten.
Maya (sec-eng): OK, record that: ingestion -> Sam, retention -> Lina, evidence export & attestation artifacts -> Maya. Can we add these to the control matrix by EOD?
Omar (devex): Ping on a small PR that wires the audit-log metadata through the router. @Sam can you review? PR: https://git.redwood/infra/audit-log/PR-482 (small change)
Sam (infra): On it. ETA today. If tests pass, can merge and deploy to staging.
Sam (infra): Quick note: ingestion pipeline will tag messages with `redwood.audit.acct` and `redwood.audit.purpose`. Will need the retention policy to read `redwood.audit.acct` for scoped deletions.
Lina (platform): Ack — retention service will look for `redwood.audit.*` tags. Can you paste the exact tag names?
Sam (infra): Done above. Also will enable partitioning by `redwood.audit.acct` so deletions are efficient.
Maya (sec-eng): For evidence export, we need a script that pulls logs for a given control id and timeframe. I sketched this command yesterday:
```
# export logs for control C-3
./tools/export_audit.sh --control C-3 --from 2025-08-01 --to 2025-10-01 --out control-C3-2025.qcow2
```
Maya (sec-eng): I'll put the script in `sec/tools` repo and add unit tests.
Auditor-Jen: Can the export include object-level checksums and a signed manifest? We need chain-of-custody.
Maya (sec-eng): Yes — plan is sha256 manifests + GPG-signed metadata.
Omar (devex): FYI I'm adding a short doc to the onboarding checklist so new engineers know how to tag events with `redwood.audit.*`.
Sam (infra): Testing note: staging ingestion failed 1/50 due to a schema mismatch (null user_id). I've opened an issue: #1227. Will patch and re-run.
Lina (platform): If user_id can be null, retention service must still support scoped deletion. I'll add guard logic.
Maya (sec-eng): Ownership recap: Sam = ingestion + pipeline PRs, Lina = retention config + guard logic, Maya = evidence export + attestation, Omar = docs/onboarding for tagging. Auditor-Jen = acceptance criteria for retention windows.
Maya (sec-eng): Action items: 1) Sam merge PR-482 and patch #1227 (due today) 2) Lina update retention service (due 2026-01-09) 3) Maya push export script + tests (due 2026-01-11) 4) Omar add tagging doc (due 2026-01-08)
Sam (infra): I created a tiny checklist in the control matrix row and assigned tasks. Linking here: https://docs.redwood/sec/control-matrix#row-C3
Auditor-Jen: Thx all. I'll verify once staging export is available. If you want me to sign off earlier, add sample manifests.
sec-bot: Reminder scheduled — fieldwork dry run on 2026-01-12 16:00 UTC. :bell:
